presentation_statement: Because no universal gold standard exists for therapeutic target causality, we constructed a high-confidence dermatology reference standard using independent, externally curated evidence sources and strict concordance rules.

label_policy.driver: High-confidence DRIVER only when known-drug and/or strong genetics concord with an independent supporting pillar; no reliance on literature alone.
label_policy.non_driver: High-confidence NON-DRIVER when association is correlative-only (expression/literature) without genetics, known-drug, or animal-model support.
label_policy.unresolved: All other pairs. UNRESOLVED is neither a positive nor negative evaluation label.

evaluation_policy.note: We designed evaluation to reduce dependence on subjective internal labeling.
